stem_book: An external pressure of 2 atm is applied on a frictionless movable piston fitted in a vessel containing 100 g of X(l) at 450 K. Heat is supplied keeping the pressure constant till 40 g of X is evaporated to form X(g) at 500 K (boiling point). Calculate the change in internal energy (ΔU) in kJ for the overall process. Assume the vapour of X behaves as an ideal gas and the volume of the liquid is negligible. Given: molar heat capacity of X(l) = 60 J/mol·K; ΔH_vaporisation = 30 kJ/mol; R = 8.3 J/mol·K; atomic weight of X = 20 g/mol. [Fill your answer by multiplying it with 100.]
reason: Printed key 25.5 kJ; working gives ΔH = 15 + 60 = 75 kJ, ΔU = 75 − 8.3 = 66.7 kJ (×100 = 6670) — key fits no reading of the data.
